links.comparator_used: Baseline prompts without the knowledge-guided mitigation prompt (original user phrasings)
links.outcome: Information dilution, including underinformative simplification, in responses to low health-literacy signals
links.effect: Reduced information dilution for most models; largest reductions in underinformative simplification for Claude (~8%) and Qwen (~6%)
links.quote: A knowledge-guided mitigation prompt reduces information dilution for most models, with the largest reductions in underinformative simplification observed for Claude (~8%) and Qwen (~6%).
